title: Score Object
description: A heterogeneous set of score events sharing one media and one timeline: each event type keeps its own strictly typed payload schema in its own block, yet all blocks travel in the same file. A tabular export is the outer union of the blocks, i.e. a sparse table where only the columns of an event's payload type are filled.

bopp_version.description: The Semantic Version of the BOPP schema (e.g., 1.0.0)

events.description: One block per event type; blocks may use different payload types but should share the extent unit.
